# Permit Acquisition
- 1.
 Department heads are cleared to approve permits for controlled items of Category 3 and below related to their department.

 1.1
 This should not be done without proper cause.

 - 2.
 The Warden may grant permits for controlled items of Category 2 and below. The Head of Security and Captain may grant permits for controlled items of Category 3 and below.

 2.2
 Permits for controlled items of Category 4 or 5 may be approved via Central Command decree if requested, but not on their own authority. - 3.
 The approval of permits is a privilege, not a right, and no head of a department is obligated to approve any permit. - 4.
 Permits are invalid if not kept on their owner's person.
